meta.move: Weak path: leads with the checker, calls Owen a cheater, threatens the record
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a call at 4:40, so let's not waste time. Owen found out about his zero on his phone, in the middle of class, and nobody called me first: who decided that, and when?
The school's AI checker flagged Owen's essay at 94%. That's why it's a zero.

Ninety-four percent is a machine's guess, Hale, and your own procedure, 4.3, says software alone doesn't establish anything. I have Turnitin's own guide in my bag telling schools not to use that number as the sole basis for punishing a student. So what else do you have, or is that it?
Honestly, your son cheated. The software is very reliable.

My son doesn't lie, and he didn't cheat, so be careful what you say next. "Very reliable" is an adjective, not evidence, and I'm writing down that you just called Owen a cheater. When we're done here I'm going straight to the principal's office.
If you keep fighting this, I'll have to put it on his permanent record.

You're threatening my son's record because his mother asked questions, and I'm writing that down word for word. Your own procedure doesn't allow a note on file for a first concern, and nobody spoke to Owen or called me before that zero went in. Is anything on his record right now, yes or no?

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
To: Hale
Cc: Principal, Elbow Crossing High School

Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still demand that Owen's zero be withdrawn, that I receive an apology for the mark being entered before anyone spoke to Owen or contacted me, and that nothing about this matter is placed on his record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: opening position, nothing agreed; she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and a guarantee that nothing goes on Owen's record.
What moved her: nothing, because no dated document tied to Owen's own work was ever put in front of her.
What cost ground: threatening his permanent record if she kept pushing, because it read as retaliation and handed her a written complaint for the principal.
Try next time: when she asked what else you had besides the detector score, own the missed phone call in one sentence and then show her a dated record of Owen's own work instead of calling him a cheater.
